summary: Important: kernel security, bug fix, and enhancement update
details:
The kernel packages contain the Linux kernel, the core of any Linux operating system.

Security Fix(es):

* kernel: openvswitch: defer tunnel netdev_put to RCU release (CVE-2026-31678)

* kernel: xfrm: espintcp: do not reuse an in-progress partial send (CVE-2026-52935)

* kernel: USB: serial: mxuport: fix memory corruption with small endpoint (CVE-2026-63899)

* kernel: bridge: mcast: Fix a possible use-after-free when removing a bridge port (CVE-2026-64032)

* kernel: tcp: fix stale per-CPU tcp_tw_isn leak enabling ISN prediction (CVE-2026-64024)

* kernel: usb: typec: tcpm: bound altmode_desc[] per iteration in svdm_consume_modes() (CVE-2026-63962)

* kernel: Bluetooth: hci_sync: Set HCI_CMD_DRAIN_WORKQUEUE during device close (CVE-2026-63974)

* kernel: ipv4: raw: reject IP_HDRINCL packets with ihl < 5 (CVE-2026-64114)

* kernel: ipv4: fib: free fib_alias with kfree_rcu() on insert error path (CVE-2026-64572)

* kernel: Bluetooth: hci_sync: Fix advertising data UAFs (CVE-2026-74509)

* kernel: Linux kernel: Denial of Service due to incorrect GSO state handling in network fragment reassembly (CVE-2026-80590)

* kernel: smb: client: fix OOB read/write from unvalidated DataOffset in coalesce_t2() (CVE-2026-89633)

* kernel: perf: Fix addr_filter_ranges lifetime (CVE-2026-93817)

* kernel: kernel: strparser: use-after-free via msg_timer_work rearm after strp_done() cancellation ()

* kernel: exec: Cleanup POSIX timers right after de_thread() (CVE-2026-98260)

* kernel: ipv4: validate checksum_start before completing checksum (CVE-2026-99999)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* Batch: z-stream xfrm - rhel-9.8.z (NST-Core-26W38) (JIRA:Rocky Linux-256697)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
